newsitem.title: UK: Options-Coffee vols soar as May bubbles above 1,70.
newsitem.headline: Options-Coffee vols soar as May bubbles above 1,70.

text.p: Coffee volatilities have shot up to 50 percent as players reposition against explosive futures prices, while demand for cocoa calls is picking up.
Robusta options saw a burst in activity this week, culminating in Wednesday's 2,291-lot volume, centred on May and July at-the-money strikes including put and call spreads.
Traders said it was difficult to detect market sentiment in a highly mixed pack of strategies that came into vogue after May futures rocketed to $1,820 per tonne on Wednesday.
"There are so many different strategies. You can never tell what people's ideas are," said one London options trader.
The highlight of the week was May $1,700 calls, which some players rolled into $1,800 to benefit from cheaper premiums.

Other traders, flabbergasted at the market's stamina, were buying protection against the risk of frost in Brazil which in 1994 fuelled prices to $4,000. They were selling May $1,700 calls for July $1,900 calls at a discount of two percent.
A call spread featured in Thursday's quieter 452-lot turnover between July $1,700-$2,000 at a six-percent spread.
